principles.name: Cross-functional teams own end-to-end
principles.statement: A single team owns the solution from design through operation; handovers between build and run teams are exceptions
principles.rationale: Ownership separation between build and run is the root cause of unaddressed operability debt
implications: On-call responsibility is part of the build team's remit
Operability is a build-time concern, not a hand-off concern

principles.name: Architecture review gates cross-domain solutions
principles.statement: Solutions touching more than one architecture domain require Architecture Council sign-off before commitment
principles.rationale: Cross-domain risk is invisible to single-domain reviewers; the only place to surface it is at the cross-domain forum
implications: Commitment gate in the PMO checklist
Architecture Council membership represents all five domains
Council decisions are recorded as ADRs

principles.name: Decisions are recorded as ADRs
principles.statement: Material architecture decisions are captured as Architecture Decision Records and stored alongside the solution
principles.rationale: Undocumented decisions are re-litigated repeatedly and reverse-engineered painfully
implications: Every solution carries at least the headline ADRs in its repository
ADRs precede implementation of the affected decision
Status, context, decision, and consequence are all captured

principles.name: Reference patterns first
principles.statement: Solution architects search the existing solution-pattern catalogue before commissioning anything bespoke
principles.rationale: Bespoke solutions multiply the maintenance estate and drift away from common patterns over time
implications: Reuse search is documented before architecture review
Architecture review rejects designs that duplicate an existing pattern without justification
The pattern catalogue is curated, not just collected

principles.name: Production readiness is a design quality
principles.statement: Operability, observability, and security are designed into the solution from the start
principles.rationale: Retro-fitting these qualities is expensive and frequently incomplete
implications: A "production-readiness checklist" exists and is signed off pre-release
Disaster recovery and security posture are tested before go-live

principles.name: SLOs per service, error budgets for change
principles.statement: Every service has an SLO; change pace is gated by remaining error budget
principles.rationale: Without explicit reliability targets, change is the dominant cause of incidents
implications: SLOs published per service alongside the contract
Reliability is an ongoing investment, not a one-off project

activity.notes: Reviewed and refined during the 2026-Q1 architecture cycle.
